text:
Alex: Heads up — seeing a stuck cleanup in eu-west app-of-apps that’s blocking GPU pool scale-ups. ArgoCD shows a failing delete on a NetworkPolicy + cloud NIC quota errors in the infra logs.
ops-bot: Alert: argocd/app-of-apps-eu-west sync failed (cleanup error) — see argocd-server logs for details :rotating_light:
Marta: Can you paste the failing error? quick grep from argocd-server?
Alex: sure — argocd-server log snippet: 
```
E 2026-03-18T15:12:03Z sync.go:254 cleanup failed for grafana/monitoring: delete failed: error deleting NetworkPolicy "np-monitoring": googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'IN_USE_ADDRESSES' exceeded, quotaExceeded
```
Sanjay: That looks like a cloud NIC/secondary IP quota, not K8s itself. We've hit this before when we accidentally created many load balancer backends during a rollout.
Riley: Related: terraform apply for vpc-subnets ran yesterday in eu-west and it shows we added two ENI subnets. Could be a drift where terraform created extra ip allocations.
Jessica: I saw an ArgoCD reconcile storm earlier — many apps tried to delete namespaces at once during the prune/cleanup window. Could have triggered ephemeral LB creation and exhausted in-use IPs.
Marta: Timeline check: did the prune job run at 15:10? Our scheduled prune window is 15:00-15:15.
Alex: yes, prune started 15:09:41 (argocd-prune-controller). That's when we got the first quota errors.
Sanjay: Quick mitigation: pause app-of-apps prune and mark the GPU-pool app as 'preserveResources: true' so scale-up can proceed. Also file a ticket to request quota bump if needed.
Riley: Before we change GitOps config, we should confirm which resources are causing new IP allocations. Run `kubectl get svc -A -o wide` and `gcloud compute addresses list --filter=region:eu-west` to see in-use addresses.
Alex: Ran the svc check: a bunch of jobs created ClusterIP services and one LoadBalancer svc in monitoring namespace that got stuck in pending. Output: `Service "grafana-lb" status: LoadBalancer: provisioning -> error: quotaExceeded`
Marta: If we flip prune off mid-window, ArgoCD will stop deleting namespaces, but can leave orphaned resources. We should be careful. Proposed short plan: 1) Pause prune for app-of-apps (short window) 2) Scale GPU pool manually to avoid prod impact 3) Investigate terraform drift & release fix 4) Re-run prune after quota resolution. Thoughts?
Jessica: +1. Also add a temporary argocd override: `spec.syncOptions: ["Prune=false"]` on app-of-apps to be surgical. Then we can let the autoscaler do a manual bump.
Sanjay: I'll request quota bump with cloud ops (support ticket opened). Meanwhile I'll run a dry terraform plan against VPC to find accidental resource adds.
Riley: I found a dangling terraform state file in the region-specific workspace that wasn't included in the last run — likely caused the duplicate ENI. I'll coordinate to remove the orphan state and import the correct resources.
Alex: Performing the `kubectl patch` now to add Prune=false to the app-of-apps. Patching...
ops-bot: Info: argocd/app-of-apps-eu-west patched by Alex (Prune=false) at 2026-03-18T15:16:02Z
Alex: Patched. Confirmed ArgoCD stopped trying to delete. GPU scale-up now unblocked, starting manual scale.
Jessica: Manual scale initiated: increased dedicated-gpu-pool replicas from 2 -> 4. Monitoring for slow node provisioning.
Sanjay: Terraform plan shows an untracked resource: `google_compute_address.monitoring_lb_ip` present in cloud but not in state. That explains the in-use addresses. Will import then re-run plan.
Marta: After import, we should run a canary prune: set Prune=false for everything except one test app, re-enable prune for that app to validate cleanup flow. If all good, re-enable globally.
Riley: Also add a small safety in our GitOps controller config: limit concurrent prune operations to 3 for eu-west to avoid mass LB churn. ArgoCD offers `resource.customizations.health` hack to throttle — we can add a controller-side rate limit.
Alex: Good call. Filing follow-ups: 1) quota ticket 2) import orphan IPs + re-run TF 3) add argocd concurrency guard 4) postmortem for prune timing in release docs.
Jessica: I'll add the postmortem and update runbook with a 'if quotaExceeded during prune' section.
Sanjay: Ticket link: https://cloudsupport.example.org/ticket/CS-34211 (requesting IN_USE_ADDRESSES bump for eu-west)
Marta: Thanks all. If anything changes ping #oncall. For now we unblocked the GPU pool and prevented further cascade. :thumbsup:
Alex: Closing thread once TF import + quota confirmed. Will update here with final timestamps and the PR for argocd concurrency changes.
